decoding: one argument, bounded visitors without untrusted preallocation, no skipped values/extensions/unknown optional coercion or trailing bytes; actual reserved source marker adapter

evidence.body: 64 lowercase ASCII request hash then 64 lowercase ASCII raw reply hash
evidence.raw: SHA-256 of exact raw bytes including order and absence

fields.absence: absent optional values remain absent, not defaults, upload inputs or qualification
fields.globals: ordered optional SDK globals; preserve absent slots and f32/f64 bits, reject v128 above 128 bits
fields.integers: required nat64 fields retain full range; no size sum or total-transfer inference

golden_registry.construction: independent DIDL, field hashes, LEB128, numeric/float bytes and SHA-256; all registered cases tested

grants: no fresh read permission, signing, dispatch, spending, complete transfer/upload, receipt, reconciliation, terminal or release
integration_owned: fresh snapshot-read access and original per-call accounting
data extents, authentic capture and stable bytes
kind: ephemeral metadata request/reply codec; no persisted product record or provider

request.arguments: exact canonical canister_id and 1..256 raw snapshot_id bytes
request.hash_owner: existing ic-management-request/v1 digest; six-method v1 record unchanged
